description: Reads the site's robots.txt and tells, robot by robot (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, DuckAssistBot, Meta, Common Crawl, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended), whether it may read the site, separating robots that read for a person (live) from robots that harvest for training. Returns the corrected robots.txt that lets the live readers in while keeping the site's existing rules, ready to paste. Requires this connector's access pass (€9.90 for 24 hours, or €29 per month).
